question_text: The two straight lines shown in the displacement ($d$) - time ($t$) graph represent the motions of two objects A and B starting from rest at time $t = 0$ and moving along the same straight line. Which of the following statements made about the motions of the objects is true?

options.option_text: The object A has travelled for a longer time than B.
Object A has a greater acceleration than B.
Both objects have the same velocity at the point where the two straight lines intersect.
Object A has a greater made displacement greater than A.
Both objects have the same made displacement at $t_0$.
